lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a roughly rectangular grid posterior to the gill slits, showing a transition from dense, small clusters to larger, regularly spaced nodes along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal linear features running across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 non-uniform high-luminance blobs contained within the perimeter of the first dorsal fin's visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast commensal organisms (remoras) located along the ventral-lateral margin and beneath the pectoral fin.
